Your holdings: SOXL (-47.72%) and SPAL (-44.47%) are both leveraged ETFs flagged "SELL" or "NEW" with significant losses. Remember, margin amplifies these drops. SMH is also down nearly 10%.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the inflation report due Wednesday, as it could impact Fed policy and broader market sentiment. Also, monitor your leveraged ETFs closely.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged positions aggressively and stay alert for macro data.
plays: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL given its -47.72% loss and leveraged decay, especially on margin.
Review SPAL's -44.47% loss; it's a new, leveraged position that moves fast and decays.
Consider RGTI for a new long, aligning with positive AI sentiment. Scanner entry 17.79-17.71, stop 17.51.
